name: Headless commerce: Vendure + Next.js
description: Headless e-commerce template with Vendure, Next.js storefront, Stripe, PostgreSQL, Redis, and container-first deployment with TLS at the edge.
longDescription: Commerce reference implementation pairing Vendure on Node.js with a Next.js storefront. GraphQL Shop and Admin APIs support Stripe payments, EU VAT oriented custom fields, and object storage for assets. The storefront uses SSR, modern UI components, and a clear client-server boundary for data fetching. Deployment is container-first with compose files, health-checked services, reverse proxy for automatic HTTPS, and repeatable build workflows. Environment separation keeps dev and production shapes explicit.
features: Multi-channel commerce core with orders, products, and admin API
Next.js storefront with theme contract and GraphQL client
Stripe payment flows and asset storage integration
GraphQL schema as the integration contract between storefront and core
Reverse proxy configuration for automatic HTTPS
Repeatable build and lifecycle workflows for container deploys
highlights: End-to-end headless pattern from catalog through checkout
TLS at the proxy with secrets only via environment configuration
Operational compose stacks that mirror practical container workflows
challenges: Headless commerce requires alignment between storefront UX, payment webhooks, and database migrations.
solutions: Shared workspace tooling, health-checked compose services, documented environment separation, and webhook verification discipline.
security: Secrets and keys only via environment configuration
Reverse proxy and TLS termination for production shapes
Stripe and webhook configuration treated as sensitive operations
Database and cache network exposure limited to the compose network
Object storage configured with least-privilege credentials
